svg.title: Azure OpenAI v1 Routing - default topology
svg.desc: Four subscription-protected APIs each expose POST /chat/completions and POST /responses with distinct policies: body, header, subscription, and recommended. Recommended combines header-first model selection with validated subscription priority. Each of gpt-5-mini and gpt-5-nano has two pools sharing three concrete backends and their circuit breakers. The same three Microsoft Foundry accounts each contain both PAYG OpenAI model deployments. Pool memberships show priorities and weights. Tier labels are simulated. Requests use managed identity, with one backend attempt and no retries.

g.text: Default: 4 APIs | 2 models | 4 pools | 6 backends | 3 Microsoft Foundry resources | 6 deployments
Each subscription-protected v1 API: POST /chat/completions and POST /responses
Convention-based routing; no model lookup table and no body rewriting
Selected model topology below. Names omit <sample-name>-. P = priority, W = weight.

Solid blue = standard pool membership. Dashed purple = priority pool membership. Choose one backend per request.
Managed identity -> matched v1 operation. One attempt; no retries. Breakers affect subsequent selections.
Foundry hosts all PAYG deployments. global-standard / ptu / consumption are simulated labels, not service tiers.
